subject: Re: Databridge AI GCP listing & co-sell enablement
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@databridge.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Redwood co-sell & GCP marketplace listing

Hi Marissa —

Quick intro: I’m Alicia, Head of Partnerships at Databridge AI. We build a vector-native feature store and embedding search layer used by several enterprise analytics platforms. We’re finalizing our GCP Marketplace listing and exploring co-sell alignment with Redwood to surface our joint solution to GCP field teams and ISV partners.

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood advise on the GCP listing intake and co-sell entitlements?
- Who should we engage for technical evidence (metering, deployment guide) and for GTM/co-sell enablement?
- We’d like a quick sync next week to map a mutual action plan.

I attached our product one-pager and a short playbook.

Thanks —
Alicia Ramos
Head of Partnerships | Databridge AI
(alicia.ramos@databridge.ai)
Attachment: Databridge_Product_OnePager.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Interest in Redwood co-sell & GCP marketplace listing

Team — forwarding an inbound from Databridge (ISV building embedding infra). Looks like a good fit for GCP co-sell and potentially a packaged listing with our GCP-optimized runtime.

Key asks from Alicia: intake + evidence for listing, and co-sell entitlement discussion with GCP field.

Proposed next steps (please weigh in by EOD):
- Ben: lead GTM/co-sell engagement and field outreach prep.
- Olga: checklist for GCP listing evidence and owner for intake form. I attached an intake template to start (RBW_GCP_Listing_Intake_Form.xlsx).
- Naomi: confirm whether we need a special SKU or can use existing listing tags for "inference+partner".
- Vivek: surface any channel compensation/credits we should offer for early co-sell wins.

I’ll propose a 30-min sync with Alicia on Mon (9/13). If we can split the initial evidence ask and have a draft MAP (mutual action plan) before the call, we’ll look sharper to the partner.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Partner Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: RBW_GCP_Listing_Intake_Form.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Interest in Redwood co-sell & GCP marketplace listing

Great — I’ll take point on GTM and field enablement. Quick operational plan below: 

1) Evidence & listing (Olga)
   - Marketplace evidence we typically need: deployment diagram, metering integration doc, security/tenant isolation note, sample billing CSVs.
   - Olga, can you confirm which of those Databridge already has and where the gaps are?

2) Co-sell qualification (Marissa + Ben)
   - Draft a short MAP for the first 90 days: joint demos, 2 pilot accounts, one co-sell win target.

3) Enablement assets (Naomi)
   - 1-pager for field, one slide for solution brief, and a short demo script showing Redwood + Databridge flow.

4) Channel economics (Vivek)
   - Propose a limited-time referral credit for first three co-sell wins; we can front credits and reconcile on ARR. Vivek, will you model a simple credit band (e.g., $5k/$10k based on deal size) and share?

I attached an evidence checklist I use for marketprep. If we can bundle those items, we should be able to submit to GCP marketplace ops within 2 weeks.

—Ben
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Marketplace_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@databridge.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Databridge AI GCP listing & co-sell enablement

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for reaching out and for the one-pager. We’re excited about the potential fit. Short version from our side: we can support both the GCP Marketplace intake and a co-sell enablement track.

Proposed next steps (can we confirm on a quick call?):
- 30-min sync early next week to align on targets and timelines (I suggested Mon 9/13 at 9:30am PT; I’ll send an invite once you confirm).
- Before the call: please share any existing merchant/billing test data and a deployment diagram showing where Databridge will run in customers’ projects. Those items map directly to the evidence checklist our marketplace team needs.
- We’ll prepare a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a 1-pager for GCP field by the meeting. Ben will own GTM/co-sell and Naomi will draft enablement slides.

If helpful, here are the items we’ll submit to GCP ops once we have the intake filled: RBW_GCP_Listing_Intake_Form.xlsx (attached), deployment diagram, security note, metering sample, and a short demo video link.

On the call we can also decide whether to pursue a packaged listing (Redwood-managed runtime + Databridge) vs. a reference listing that surfaces integration details. We can move faster with the reference listing but packaged gives better co-sell economics.

Looking forward —
